title: Nonnegativity of decoding edge value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let $T$ be a long-code table, let $\varepsilon$ be real, and choose a default label in $\{0,\ldots,q-1\}$. For every vertex and each of its neighbors, the decoding edge value obtained by averaging the permutation-consistency indicator over the decoding candidate sets at the two endpoints is nonnegative.
